thread:
maria: Heads up — PR #9123 is ready for merge but microbench on 4k sequence shows slight p95 latency increase. Need quick eyes and an approval. Attaching trimmed bench output.

aj: which test/command did you run? link to bench artifacts?

maria: ran `tools/bench/run_microbench --seq 4k --it 50 --config small-batch` — artifact: s3://bench/artifacts/9123/499999

benchbot: artifact uploaded: https://bench.redwood/499999/9123 (results.csv)

oliver: quick skim: p95 up from 86ms -> 98ms on cpu-bound jobs, throughput same. memory+ GPU mem shows +120MB in 4k case. paste of values:
``` 
baseline p95=86ms throughput=950 req/s gpu_mem=3220MB
pr-9123 p95=98ms throughput=945 req/s gpu_mem=3340MB
```

aj: that's small but noticeable. Is this from the new prefill optimization? any kernel changes?

maria: change was a micro-io reordering in kv-cache eviction path — expected to reduce stalls for longseq, but might add a copy on small-batch paths.

oliver: can we isolate by running with `--kv-evict=off` vs `on` to confirm? if it's eviction delta then canary with fallback is fine.

maria: ran quick diff, with `--kv-evict=off` p95=87ms so it points to eviction. full log in artifact.

aj: OK. my vote: require canary on dedicated pool + fallback to previous alloc if tail > 95ms. Who owns canary roll?

devops-oncall: I can schedule a 30-min canary in the next merge window (UTC 02:00). Need a playbook entry for rollback and health checks.

maria: adding rollout plan: canary 1% for 10m -> 10% for 15m -> 100% if no tail spike. Health checks: p95, error rate, gpu mem.

oliver: add metric: per-route p99 and kv-cache evict count. Also add an alert if p95 increases by >10% vs baseline.

aj: sounds good. If we get 2 approvals I can merge and kick canary. I'm giving LGTM pending canary: :+1:

maria: thanks! tagging @oliver for second approval.

oliver: LGTM — approve. :thumbsup:

maria: merging after canary scheduled. I'll post results here once completed.

benchbot: canary job created: https://ci.redwood/canary/9123/499999

maria: thanks all — will follow up with post-canary numbers.
